title: Research only: three papers and an abstract, with affiliations in the excerpts

evidence.title: Hierarchical Bayesian models for small-area poverty estimates
evidence.excerpt: Department of Statistics, University of Westmere. We propose a hierarchical Bayesian model that borrows strength across neighbouring areas to estimate poverty rates where survey samples are small.

evidence.title: Adjusting for nonresponse in household surveys with auxiliary data
evidence.excerpt: We compare weighting and model-based adjustments for unit nonresponse using administrative auxiliary data.

evidence.title: Small-area estimation under informative sampling
evidence.excerpt: University of Westmere and Ostrow Institute. We extend small-area estimators to designs where selection depends on the outcome.

evidence.title: Nonresponse bias in panel surveys (talk abstract)
evidence.excerpt: A short talk on how attrition in panel surveys biases change estimates, and simple diagnostics.
